name: Tamames (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tamames (crossed flags and drums on red, a pot and a tree on white).
history: The arms of Tamames were approved on 29 January 1988; the municipal flag was approved by the Real Academia de la Historia on 4 February 2000 and is square, divided horizontally through the middle, white above and red below, with the crowned arms superimposed at the centre.
